description: Every point is the least upper bound of the dense-subset points strictly below it.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.DenseLinearOrders.dense_lower_lub.{u} {α : Type u} [LinearOrder α] [DenselyOrdered α]
  [NoMinOrder α] (D : Set α) (hD : Lemmatheca.SetTheory.DenseLinearOrders.OrderDense D) (x : α) :
  IsLUB {d | d ∈ D ∧ d < x} x
